scripts.dev: npm run update_db && node scripts/run-app.mjs --mode dev
scripts.build: node scripts/clean-worker.mjs && node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p tsconfig.worker.json && next build
scripts.build:fast: node scripts/clean-worker.mjs && node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p tsconfig.worker.json && next build --experimental-app-only
scripts.start: npm run update_db && node scripts/run-app.mjs --mode start
scripts.db_build_start: npm run update_db && npm run build && npm run start
scripts.build_and_start: npm run install_deps && npm run db_build_start
scripts.typecheck: node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit --incremental false && node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p tsconfig.worker.json --noEmit
scripts.test:all: node scripts/clean-worker.mjs && node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p tsconfig.worker.json && node scripts/run-all-tests.mjs
scripts.ci: npm run generate:prisma && npm run typecheck && npm run lint:ci && npm run test:all && npm run build
scripts.test:remote: node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p tsconfig.worker.json && node --test scripts/cloudflaredConfig.test.mjs scripts/remoteClient.test.mjs scripts/jobsApiList.test.mjs scripts/queueSync.test.mjs scripts/openRouterPricing.test.mjs
scripts.test:projects: node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p tsconfig.worker.json && node --test scripts/projects.test.mjs scripts/projectsLifecycle.test.mjs scripts/projectSetup.test.mjs
scripts.test:file-serving: node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p tsconfig.worker.json && node --test scripts/fileServing.test.mjs scripts/remoteAssets.test.mjs scripts/sampleThumbnails.test.mjs
scripts.test:basic: node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p tsconfig.worker.json && node --test scripts/basicUtils.test.mjs scripts/pathContainment.test.mjs
scripts.test:caption-bulk: node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p tsconfig.worker.json && node --test scripts/captionKeywordSearch.test.mjs scripts/datasetCaptionBulk.test.mjs scripts/datasetRefusalCaptionAudit.test.mjs
scripts.test:job-datasets: node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p tsconfig.worker.json && node --test scripts/jobDatasetDefaults.test.mjs scripts/remoteDatasetRefs.test.mjs scripts/remoteDatasetSync.test.mjs scripts/remoteStartProgress.test.mjs scripts/remoteClientUpload.test.mjs scripts/remoteJobMissing.test.mjs
scripts.test:encrypted-dataset-secrets: node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p tsconfig.worker.json && node --test scripts/encryptedDatasetSecrets.test.mjs scripts/encryptedDatasets.test.mjs
scripts.test:secure-caption: node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p tsconfig.worker.json && node --test scripts/secureCaptionCrypto.test.mjs scripts/ollamaClient.test.mjs scripts/ollamaVision.test.mjs scripts/secureRemoteCaptionJobs.test.mjs scripts/remoteOllamaWorkers.test.mjs scripts/remoteCaptionJobs.test.mjs scripts/remoteCaptionResults.test.mjs
